amllVerticalSpringMass.label: Vertical Spring Mass
amllVerticalSpringMass.description: Mass of the vertical scrolling physics spring. Larger mass increases spring inertia.

amllVerticalSpringDamping.label: Vertical Spring Damping
amllVerticalSpringDamping.description: Damping of the vertical scrolling physics spring. Larger damping reduces oscillation and settles faster.

amllVerticalSpringStiffness.label: Vertical Spring Stiffness
amllVerticalSpringStiffness.description: Stiffness of the vertical scrolling physics spring. Larger stiffness pulls harder and bounces quicker.

amllVerticalSpringSoft.label: Vertical Soft Spring
amllVerticalSpringSoft.description: Forces the vertical scrolling to use a softer spring profile.

amllScaleSpringMass.label: Scale Spring Mass
amllScaleSpringMass.description: Mass of the active line scale animation. Larger mass increases scale bounce inertia.

amllScaleSpringDamping.label: Scale Spring Damping
amllScaleSpringDamping.description: Damping of the active line scale animation. Larger damping reduces scale jitter and settles faster.

amllScaleSpringStiffness.label: Scale Spring Stiffness
amllScaleSpringStiffness.description: Stiffness of the active line scale animation. Larger stiffness responds and scales quicker.

amllScaleSpringSoft.label: Scale Soft Spring
amllScaleSpringSoft.description: Forces the active line scale animation to use a softer spring profile.

autoCenterCover.label: Auto Center Cover
autoCenterCover.description: Center cover and hide lyric area when no lyrics available

mirrorLayout.label: Mirror Layout
mirrorLayout.description: Swap cover and lyric positions (disabled when cover is centered)

adaptiveFontSize.label: Adaptive Font Size
